scope: Full-file content review of the frozen v0.2.0 tracked tree. This is not model/platform acceptance. New English counterparts are additionally checked for IDs, evidence metadata, source closure and packaging.

findings.summary_zh_TW: README 的主要下載入口依賴 v0.2.0 release 附件；來源只核對 URL 字串，沒有證明遠端資產存在、可匿名取得或 hash 相符。
findings.summary_en: The primary README download relies on a v0.2.0 release asset; source checks only compare the URL string and do not establish asset existence, anonymous accessibility or byte identity.

findings.summary_zh_TW: CI 僅跑靜態驗證；第三方 Actions 用主版本標籤，敏感模式檢查排除檢查器本身，不能當成完整秘密掃描或發佈驗證。
findings.summary_en: CI runs static validation only; third-party Actions use major-version tags and the sensitive-pattern scanner excludes its own file, so it is neither comprehensive secret scanning nor release validation.

findings.summary_zh_TW: 凍結版本沒有完整英文入口、主持規約、角色／組別、方法卡、模板與示例；目前不是可獨立使用的英文版。
findings.summary_en: The frozen tree has no complete English onboarding, facilitator, persona/pack content, method cards, templates or examples; it is not a standalone English edition.

findings.summary_zh_TW: 真實 ChatGPT 端對端驗收仍停在人機驗證；靜態套件測試與編寫示例不能證明角色差異、交叉改進或懶人模式真的成功。
findings.summary_en: Real ChatGPT end-to-end acceptance remains blocked by human verification; static package tests and authored examples cannot establish persona differentiation, cross-critique or successful lazy-mode behavior.

findings.summary_zh_TW: LICENSE 明確仍待授權決策；下載使用、修改、翻譯、再散布與商用範圍尚未成為清楚的正式授權。

findings.summary_zh_TW: LAZY_COUNCIL 的前後護欄正確，但同一包仍含完整 TEACHING 與真人填寫／等待／投票指令；存在需實測的模式回退風險，尚非已觀察到的模型失敗。

findings.summary_zh_TW: 明確的輸入不可信／不洩漏資料規則主要放在 TEACHING；以 repo 入口只載入 FACILITATOR 與角色卡時不一定讀到同一套共通規範。
